document.abstract: Depending on which end of the world you find yourself, you're probably really happy or sad in late August. If you're in the Southern Hemisphere, you might be happier since your winter is ending and spring and summer are just around the corner. If you're in the Northern Hemisphere like I am, it's quite the opposite—sad that our summer is nearing its end and days of cold are coming soon. Personally, I enjoy the change of the seasons, which often leads me to a feeling of renewal, no matter what time of year.
